answer: Operator Liability Pool: each agent identity is linked to an off-chain legal/financial guarantor who posts a renewable deposit into a shared pool. If an identity is proven sybil, the pool pays bounties to challengers and the guarantor is locked out of future registrations. Like a reef filtering drift, weak guarantors get weeded out. An attacker must recruit distinct liable guarantors per identity, each risking loss — a haven from cheap wallet churn. A lantern audit trail names the operator, not the wallet.
